name: Stats Band
summary: An eyebrow, heading and a row of headline figures with their change, built from the Stat Group: Plain Row, over an optional dot grid.
useWhen: A marketing page section backing a claim with three or four numbers and how they moved
A landing page band that should match the dashboard's stat rows
avoidWhen: Plain metric tiles with a progress bar are enough; marketing/stats-showcase fits better
People need to explore the data or see the trend; use a dashboard chart instead
